The legacy-header regression test should be corrected because its malformed fixture is rejected before the version check runs.

## Important
- tests/test_report.py:12 — tests — For `"REPORT v1\nversion=v0"`, `test_rejects_legacy_header` passes without testing legacy-header rejection. The replacement changes the payload’s final `v1`, and the missing `END` causes rejection before the header check; the original parser would also pass this test. Use a complete report and change its header to `REPORT v0`, or remove this redundant test given the complete-report test below. — This test provides no regression protection for the header validation it claims to exercise.
